state.paragraph: On August 14, 2013, representatives of Party A attended a management presentation at the Boston office of Goodwin Procter with members of Mac-Gray management, representatives of BofA Merrill Lynch and the two members of the Transaction Committee.

ledger_rows.Note: Information access differs by bidder type: B and C (financial) get broad data-room access; A and CSC/Pamplona (strategic) get limited access, customer data withheld, plus synergy talks. All four had management presentations 08/06-08/14.

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
